objective: Add resumable long-running report generation to invoice-svc: submit returns 202 immediately, an in-process pool of 3 workers executes jobs with persisted state, restarts recover in-flight jobs, and status is queryable by job id.
in_scope: POST /reports endpoint returning 202 {job_id} with a persisted queued job row
In-process worker pool (3 workers) executing report jobs with persisted progress
Job state machine queued/running/retry_wait/done/failed with max 3 attempts and 1s/4s/16s backoff
Startup recovery of running (requeue+recompute) and retry_wait (reschedule) jobs
GET /reports/{job_id} status endpoint including 404 for unknown ids
Integration tasks: contract consistency, seam wiring, E2E closure, final acceptance evidence

shared_contracts.spec: report_jobs table: id UUID pk; status enum('queued','running','retry_wait','done','failed'); attempts int 0..3; progress int 0..100; result_ref nullable text; error nullable text; created_at/updated_at timestamptz. SQLAlchemy model ReportJob in app/db/models.py; alembic migration creates the table.
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: Only via CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST with evidence from execution

shared_contracts.spec: POST /reports body {input: object} -> 202 {job_id: uuid} (422 on invalid body, error shape C6). GET /reports/{job_id} -> 200 {job_id, status, attempts, progress, result_ref, error, created_at} or 404 {error: {code: 'not_found', message}} for unknown/invalid uuid.
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: Only via CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST with evidence from execution

shared_contracts.spec: States queued, running, retry_wait, done, failed. Legal transitions: queued->running; running->retry_wait (attempt < 3, backoff 1s/4s/16s by attempt number); running->done; running->failed (attempt == 3); retry_wait->running; retry_wait->failed (attempt == 3). Crash recovery: any row with status running at startup transitions running->queued (recompute, idempotent per A-2); rows in retry_wait resume their schedule. attempts increments when leaving running toward retry_wait or failed; progress written by the worker between 0..100.
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: Only via CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST with evidence from execution

shared_contracts.spec: ReportWorkerPool (app/services/report_worker.py): start(session_factory), stop(), submit(job_id: str) -> None (no-op if already queued in pool); run_job(job_id) executes one job to terminal state honoring C3. Pool size fixed at 3. Callable synchronously from tests.
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: Only via CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST with evidence from execution

shared_contracts.spec: JobStore (app/services/job_store.py), methods on a session: create_job(input_payload: dict) -> ReportJob (status queued); get(job_id) -> ReportJob|None; transition(job_id, from_status, to_status, **fields) -> ReportJob, raises IllegalTransition on illegal C3 transition; recover_stale(now) -> list[ReportJob] (running rows, per C3 recovery).
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: Only via CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST with evidence from execution

shared_contracts.spec: Error shape for all new-endpoint errors: {error: {code: str, message: str}}. Codes: 'not_found' (GET unknown id), 'invalid_body' (422). Job-level failure stored as report_jobs.error = {code: 'generation_failed', message: <str(exc)>} text field.
shared_contracts.unfreeze_rule: Only via CONTRACT_CHANGE_REQUEST with evidence from execution

integration_seams.description: API submit path: POST /reports persists a queued row and the pool picks it up; response carries the job_id the status endpoint later serves
Worker persistence: state transitions (running/retry_wait/done/failed) and attempts/progress updates written through JobStore match C3 exactly
Lifecycle: lifespan starts the pool after recovery runs; startup recovery requeues stale running rows and resumes retry_wait schedules; shutdown drains the pool

acceptance.description: POST /reports with a valid payload returns HTTP 202 with body containing job_id, and a report_jobs row exists with status 'queued'
acceptance.positive_case: a valid payload {input: {...}} is submitted and a queued row is created
acceptance.negative_case: a payload missing the 'input' field returns 422
acceptance.evidence: pytest tests/api/test_reports.py::test_submit_returns_202 asserts response.status_code == 202 and row status == 'queued'

acceptance.description: With the stub generator, a submitted job reaches status 'done' with progress 100 and result_ref set
acceptance.negative_case: no negative case — this criterion asserts the happy path only; proven by the named test
acceptance.failure_behavior: no failure behavior in this criterion — the error path is covered by A4, asserted by its test
acceptance.evidence: pytest tests/e2e/test_reports_flow.py::test_submit_to_done asserts row status 'done', progress 100, result_ref not null

acceptance.description: Crash recovery: a job left in status 'running' is re-queued at startup, recomputed exactly once, and reaches 'done'
acceptance.positive_case: app restarted with a running row present
acceptance.negative_case: no stale rows at startup — recovery performs a no-op and a test asserts the row count is unchanged
acceptance.failure_behavior: requeue transition running->queued rejected would leave the job stuck; test asserts final status 'done'
acceptance.evidence: pytest tests/e2e/test_reports_flow.py::test_crash_recovery_resume asserts generator call count == 1 and final status 'done'

acceptance.description: A generator that always raises produces status 'failed' with attempts 3 and error set; no 4th attempt is made
acceptance.negative_case: generator raises once then succeeds (must reach 'done')
acceptance.failure_behavior: row status 'failed', attempts 3, error non-empty, call count 3
acceptance.evidence: pytest tests/e2e/test_retry.py::test_retry_exhaustion asserts status 'failed', attempts 3, generator called exactly 3 times

acceptance.positive_case: an unknown but valid-format uuid returns 404
acceptance.negative_case: a malformed uuid string returns 404 as well
acceptance.evidence: pytest tests/api/test_reports.py::test_get_unknown_404 asserts status_code == 404 and body error.code == 'not_found'

acceptance.description: GET /reports/{job_id} while the job is running returns HTTP 200 with status 'running' and progress an integer in 0..100
acceptance.positive_case: a paused generator holds the job in running state; the status read returns 200
acceptance.negative_case: no negative case — this criterion asserts a state read; the 404 behavior is covered by A5
acceptance.failure_behavior: no failure behavior in this criterion — the error shape is covered by A5, asserted by its test
